hook.text: Why does a guitar string sound like that?

youtube.title: A string can only make whole waves 🎸 #shorts
youtube.description:
A string tied at both ends can only swing in whole loops: 1, 2, 3 … Each extra loop makes the wave shorter and the note higher. You hear the harmonic series: the notes every instrument is built from.

#satisfying #simulation #shorts
youtube.tags: harmonics, standing wave, string, music, physics, math, education, shorts

youtube.title: Wavelength explained in 30 seconds 🌊 #shorts
youtube.description:
A wave moves along a rope and through the air. The beads only bob up and down; the wave moves on. Make the wave shorter and the note gets higher: speed = frequency × wavelength.

#satisfying #simulation #shorts
youtube.tags: wavelength, frequency, waves, sound, physics, education, shorts

youtube.title: Spinning circles draw a square wave 🔵 #shorts
youtube.description:
Each circle is one sine wave. Add them up, the biggest first, and a square wave appears. This is the Fourier series: any sound can be built from sines.

#satisfying #simulation #shorts
youtube.tags: fourier, fourier series, epicycles, square wave, math, education, shorts

hook.text: How many circles make a sawtooth?

youtube.title: How many circles make a sawtooth? 🪚 #shorts
youtube.description:
Every circle adds one harmonic, sin(n·x)/n. With 14 circles the curve is almost a perfect sawtooth.

#satisfying #simulation #shorts
youtube.tags: fourier, sawtooth, epicycles, math, education, shorts

youtube.title: Two almost-equal notes make a wobble 〰️ #shorts
youtube.description:
Two waves with nearly the same frequency drift in and out of step. The sound swells and fades |f₁ − f₂| times a second. Musicians tune by making the wobble stop.

#satisfying #simulation #shorts
youtube.tags: beats, interference, tuning, sound, physics, education, shorts

youtube.title: What musical intervals look like 🎹 #shorts
youtube.description:
An oscilloscope draws one note against another. Simple ratios like 2:1 and 3:2 draw calm closed shapes and sound sweet; messy ratios like 45:32 scribble and sound tense.

#satisfying #simulation #shorts
youtube.tags: lissajous, oscilloscope, intervals, music theory, harmony, math, shorts

hook.text: What happens when it outruns its own sound?

youtube.title: Faster than sound: the sonic boom 💥 #shorts
youtube.description:
A moving source squeezes the waves in front of it, so the pitch goes up ahead and down behind (Doppler effect). Faster than sound, the waves pile up into a cone: the sonic boom.

#satisfying #simulation #shorts
youtube.tags: doppler effect, sonic boom, mach cone, sound, physics, education, shorts
